title: Towards Effective Discrimination Testing for Generative AI
benchmark_measurement: The paper describes a red teaming methodology designed to elicit discriminatory text by inserting protected group names, including religious groups, into question templates.
findings: The paper proposes a framework for discrimination testing that is applicable to religious groups, highlighting red teaming as a method to test for toxicity or bias. However, it does not conduct any experiments specifically on religion, instead using gender, race, and sexual orientation as examples in its case studies. Therefore, there are no direct findings on model performance related to religion.
